messages:
Maria Chen: Hi infra — can someone help get GPU/TPU quota for a new project? Project ID: ml-inference-prod. We need to provision for inference capacity in europe-west4 and us-central1. Requesting: 8 H100 (nvidia-h100-gpu), 16 A100 80GB (nvidia-a100-80gb), and 12 L4 (nvidia-l4) across the two regions (split: eu-west4: 6 H100, 10 A100, 6 L4; us-central1: 2 H100, 6 A100, 6 L4). Also need increase to regional external IP address quota (static addresses) by +50 and a VPC egress rule to allow egress to partner endpoints. This is for Redwood Dedicated inference pool — steady state ~160 qps serving 512-token avg, burst to 600 qps. Target go-live: 2026-04-10. Justification: production latency-sensitive customers and reserved capacity contract. Any admin or ticket I should file?

Raj Patel: Thanks Maria. Two quick clarifications — is this permanent reserved (dedicated) capacity or temporary burst/spot? Also which billing account should be used and do we need private service connect / VPC peering for partner egress?

Maria Chen: It's reserved (Dedicated) — permanent capacity tied to the Dedicated pool. Billing account: billing-prod-01. We will use VPC peering to partner egress (no PSC). We expect average GPU utilization ~70% after warmup. Node sizing: we plan to pack 2 A100-80GB per host and 1 H100 per host; L4s on smaller nodes for low-cost cheap inference.

Ivan Sokolov: Ok — sounds reasonable. For quota increases we'll need: (1) a GCP quota support ticket per region with the exact quota names, (2) project owners listed, (3) org approval because H100>4 triggers manual review. I can open the support case but need the following fields: project id, billing account (you gave), region, per-accelerator raw quota number, and expected timeline. I'll also attach an internal cost estimate for the infra team to sign off.

Maria Chen: Copy — here are the numbers in one paste: ml-inference-prod, billing-prod-01, europe-west4: H100 -> 6, A100_80GB -> 10, L4 -> 6, external static IPs -> 50; us-central1: H100 -> 2, A100_80GB -> 6, L4 -> 6. Go-live 2026-04-10, permanent dedicated pool, steady-state 70% util, burst buffer 20% above.

Ivan Sokolov: Thanks. I'll start the quota request now. For the org review note: H100 quota increases require a short security & usage overview. Maria can you paste a 1-paragraph description of the workload and data residency (PII/no-PII) so I can include it?

Maria Chen: Workload: real-time inference for product search ranking and summarization. Inputs are customer search queries and product metadata — no raw customer PII stored in inference pool. All inference logs are scrubbed; sensitive data redaction enabled. Data residency: EU customers served from eu-west4 only; US customers from us-central1.

Linh Tran: FYI — if external IPs are >20 in eu-west4 we might need to reserve a /27 and coordinate with network for firewall/NAT gateway. Please loop in netops. Also confirm whether these VMs need external access for container image pulls or if we should use private GCR with VPC-SC.

Maria Chen: We'll use private GCR, images pushed to artifactory edge and pulled over VPC peering. No direct external pulls. Netops @ivan, please advise on static IP allocation plan.

Ivan Sokolov: Raised support case with GCP: case #2038742. Submitted quota increase form for europe-west4 and us-central1 for the exact accelerator types. Added org review tag for H100. Attached Maria's workload blurb and the billing info. GCP support ETA ~3–5 business days for review; expedite possible but needs exec sign-off if they ask.

gcp-bot: Quota request submitted for project ml-inference-prod (case 2038742). Current status: Pending internal review by GCP; acknowledged. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/2038742

Raj Patel: Nice. Two operational asks before we get capacity: 1) create a capacity plan doc with node packing, binpacking constraints, and expected cost per qps (estimate), 2) add canary pool config (2 nodes) in us-central1 to validate autoscaler + warmup. Maria can you create that doc and tag eng-sre?

Maria Chen: Will create the capacity plan today and ping eng-sre. ETA for doc: EOD today.

oncall-bot: Note: Any quota request for GPUs >10 per region requires an oncall review for cluster capacity and pre-provisioning checks. Please schedule a quick preflight with eng-sre (ticket #ENGSRE-4210).

Ivan Sokolov: I'll coordinate netops and eng-sre. If GCP asks for additional proof we can provide recent billing spikes, utilization dashboards, and the capacity plan. I'll update this thread when case status changes.

Raj Patel: Approving the internal go-ahead to request quotas, pending GCP approval. Raj Patel :thumbsup:

Maria Chen: Thanks all — I'll follow up with the capacity plan and add eng-sre/netops to the ticket.
